question.worked_solution:
First, we decompose all of the terms into their various factors. The $32x(5z+1)$ in the numerator becomes $2\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot x\cdot (5z+1),$ and the $12xz$ in the denominator becomes $3\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot x\cdot z.$

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}\frac{32x(5z+1)}{12xz}=\frac{2\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot x\cdot (5z+1)}{3\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot x\cdot z}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we cancel out all the pairs of common factors in the numerator and denominator. In this case, there are two pairs of $2\text{'s}$ and one pair of $x$'s.

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}\frac{2\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot x\cdot (5z+1)}{3\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot x\cdot z} & = \\ \frac{\cancel{2}\cdot \cancel{2}\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot \cancel{x}\cdot (5z+1)}{3\cdot \cancel{2}\cdot \cancel{2}\cdot \cancel{x}\cdot z} & = \\ \frac{2\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot (5z+1)}{3\cdot z} & = \\ \frac{8(5z+1)}{3z}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, the expression simplifies to $\frac{8(5z+1)}{3z}.$
